title: Unique sectionwise linear lift for coefficient realization
statement: For a site with module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], two locally bijective coefficient presentations and a compatible homomorphism of commutative coefficient rings, module realization followed by restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] is uniquely isomorphic to fixed-scalar restriction followed by module realization, with identity on every underlying sheafified section. This is the generic proved calculation used by the finite pro-etale realization comparison.

source.place: Tags 00YV, 03DA, 03DI and 03CY; the existing sectionwise sheafification and adjunction-mate calculations, separated into a compile-sized proof module.

proof.text: Lift a scalar and a module section to one common covering sieve. The two actions agree there by scalar compatibility and the given presheaf linearity. Separatedness gives the equality after sheafification.

Equip the identity on the common underlying abelian sheaf with the resulting linearity proof. Naturality holds on sections. The faithful forgetful functor reflects its invertibility. Equality on all sections gives uniqueness.

theorem realization_restrict_existsUnique
    {D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} D] (J : GrothendieckTopology D)
    [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    {Λ₁ Λ₂ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ₁] [CommRing Λ₂]
    (R S : Sheaf J RingCat.{u + 1})
    (α : (Functor.const Dᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of Λ₁) ⟶ R.obj)
    (β : (Functor.const Dᵒᵖ).obj (RingCat.of Λ₂) ⟶ S.obj)
    [Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective J α] [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J α]
    [Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective J β] [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J β]
    (φ : Λ₁ →+* Λ₂) (δ : R ⟶ S)
    (hs : α ≫ δ.hom = (Functor.const Dᵒᵖ).map (RingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ β) :
    ∃! e : moduleRealization J Λ₂ S β ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u + 1} δ ≅
        sheafCompose J (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1} φ) ⋙ moduleRealization J Λ₁ R α,
      ∀ (M : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ₂)) (U : Dᵒᵖ)
        (x : ((moduleRealization J Λ₂ S β).obj M).val.obj U),
        (e.hom.app M).val.app U x = x
